subject.title: Feature request: Read pinned Telegram messages via bot API

question: Should Telegram pinned-message reads be exposed only as an on-demand gated message action, or should OpenClaw also inject pinned content automatically at session start?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the permanent behavior decides how persistent Telegram room context is authorized, gated, surfaced to agents, and documented.

options.title: On-demand gated read
options.body: Expose a Telegram list-pins/read-pinned action through the plugin with a dedicated action gate and live Telegram proof, leaving automatic prompt injection out of scope.

options.title: Automatic pinned context
options.body: Add session-start pinned-message injection only after defining opt-in configuration, privacy, prompt-injection, and refresh semantics.

options.title: Defer to broader read design
options.body: Keep this blocked until maintainers settle the broader Telegram message-read and retained-context contract.

recommendation.title: On-demand gated read
recommendation.body: Expose a Telegram list-pins/read-pinned action through the plugin with a dedicated action gate and live Telegram proof, leaving automatic prompt injection out of scope.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the best visible owner for the product/security choice from the issue timeline and adjacent plugin-boundary history.
